tables.name: accounts
tables.comment: One row per Rainbow account. An auth.users row without a row here is not a Rainbow account and is treated as a guest by every Rainbow function (see rainbow_uid). Written only by ensure_account(), which copies global_user_id from the caller's custom:platform identity; global_user_id is the WorkOS user id, unique here, and never a key for gameplay rows.

columns.name: global_user_id
columns.comment: The shared (WorkOS) identity this local account is linked to: auth.identities.provider_id for provider custom:platform. Text, not uuid; the reserved join key for future entitlements.

constraints.name: accounts_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

indexes.name: accounts_global_user_id_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX accounts_global_user_id_key ON public.accounts USING btree (global_user_id)

indexes.name: accounts_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX accounts_pkey ON public.accounts USING btree (user_id)

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX archive_access_pkey ON public.archive_access USING btree (id)

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX archive_access_user_id_key ON public.archive_access USING btree (user_id)

tables.name: device_identities
tables.comment: One row per anonymous browser identity. token_hash is sha256 of a token returned exactly once at creation and never stored in the clear. retired_at is permanent: a retired identity can never be verified, claimed or resumed, but its gameplay rows are never touched. Since the launch baseline it also records the one-time import decision: retired_reason imported|started_fresh, claimed_by the account that decided, decided_at when.

columns.name: claimed_by
columns.comment: The Rainbow account that imported or declined this device's guest history. NULL while the device is live or if that account was later deleted.

constraints.name: device_identities_claimed_by_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (claimed_by) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

indexes.name: device_identities_claimed_by_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX device_identities_claimed_by_idx ON public.device_identities USING btree (claimed_by) WHERE (claimed_by IS NOT NULL)

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX device_identities_pkey ON public.device_identities USING btree (device_id)

constraints.name: feedback_user_id_fkey

indexes.name: feedback_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX feedback_pkey ON public.feedback USING btree (id)

columns.name: won
columns.comment: Three-state: NULL while in_progress (not yet knowable), TRUE when status=won, FALSE when status=lost. Enforced by game_sessions_status_won_check. Never read without filtering on status first.

columns.name: completed_at
columns.comment: When the game formally ended. NULL while in_progress, a real timestamp on won/lost -- both directions enforced by game_sessions_status_completed_at_check. No column default: completion code supplies the value explicitly.

columns.name: rainbow_solve_index
columns.comment: Categories already solved when the Rainbow was found (0-4); NULL when unknown/not applicable. See useGame.ts GameState.rainbowSolveIndex, the authoritative source this value is copied from.

columns.name: status
columns.comment: Lifecycle: in_progress | won | lost. in_progress <=> completed_at IS NULL and won IS NULL (both enforced). Player-facing Stats MUST filter to (won, lost) -- a row existing no longer implies a played game.

columns.name: is_official
columns.comment: True when this session owns the permanent official result for its puzzle+identity. Set at completion, not at creation: false while in progress, false for a replay that completed after an official result already existed, and (in future) for beta/playtest sessions. Player-facing Stats filter on this AND status.

columns.name: entry_context
columns.comment: How the player entered this game (daily_home, archive_calendar, free_collection, emoji_collection, archive_direct, free_legacy_link; future: beta, shared_link, ...). NOT a puzzle attribute. NULL = unknown/historical. No CHECK constraint so future values need no migration.

columns.name: started_at
columns.comment: When meaningful play began (first guess or first revealed hint) -- NOT page load. NULL for historical rows, which are never backfilled with a guessed value.

columns.name: last_activity_at
columns.comment: Time of the last meaningful action (creation, guess, hint, completion). Basis for classifying stale in_progress sessions as abandoned in later analysis. Never written from timer ticks or UI-only events. NULL for historical rows.

columns.name: bonus_rainbow_attempted
columns.comment: True when the player EXPLICITLY submitted the post-completion "Spot the Rainbow" modal at least once, correct or not. Session-level summary of guess_events.attempt_type = 'bonus_rainbow' (same relationship hints_used has to hint_events). Never inferred from the Rainbow-SHAPE heuristic is_rainbow_attempt.

columns.name: rainbow_source
columns.comment: How the Rainbow was found: in_game | post_game. NULL when not found, and NULL for historical rows (never backfilled with a guess). Read only alongside found_rainbow = true.

columns.name: puzzle_version_id
columns.comment: The puzzle_versions snapshot this session is playing. NULL = unknown (legacy session predating versioning, or a client that did not pin one) -- never backfilled or guessed. Stats key on puzzle_id, NOT on this column: every version is the same puzzle.

columns.name: format
columns.comment: The board format this play belongs to, copied from the puzzle at session creation. Existing sessions default to 'full', which is what every one of them is.

constraints.name: game_sessions_status_won_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'in_progress'::text) AND (won IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'won'::text) AND (won IS TRUE)) OR ((status = 'lost'::text) AND (won IS FALSE))))

constraints.name: game_sessions_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

indexes.name: game_sessions_format_device_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX game_sessions_format_device_idx ON public.game_sessions USING btree (format, device_id) WHERE (device_id IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: game_sessions_format_user_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX game_sessions_format_user_idx ON public.game_sessions USING btree (format, user_id) WHERE (user_id IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: game_sessions_in_progress_activity_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX game_sessions_in_progress_activity_idx ON public.game_sessions USING btree (last_activity_at) WHERE (status = 'in_progress'::text)

indexes.name: game_sessions_one_official_per_device
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX game_sessions_one_official_per_device ON public.game_sessions USING btree (puzzle_id, device_id) WHERE (is_official AND (user_id IS NULL) AND (device_id IS NOT NULL) AND (device_id <> 'unknown'::text))

indexes.name: game_sessions_one_official_per_user
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX game_sessions_one_official_per_user ON public.game_sessions USING btree (puzzle_id, user_id) WHERE (is_official AND (user_id IS NOT NULL))

indexes.name: game_sessions_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX game_sessions_pkey ON public.game_sessions USING btree (id)

indexes.name: game_sessions_puzzle_device_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX game_sessions_puzzle_device_idx ON public.game_sessions USING btree (puzzle_id, device_id)

indexes.name: game_sessions_puzzle_user_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX game_sessions_puzzle_user_idx ON public.game_sessions USING btree (puzzle_id, user_id)

indexes.name: game_sessions_puzzle_version_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX game_sessions_puzzle_version_idx ON public.game_sessions USING btree (puzzle_version_id) WHERE (puzzle_version_id IS NOT NULL)

triggers.name: game_sessions_sync_status_trigger
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER game_sessions_sync_status_trigger BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.game_sessions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION game_sessions_sync_status()

policies.name: Admins can read all game sessions
Users can read own game sessions

columns.name: is_rainbow_attempt
columns.comment: True when this guess was shaped like a Rainbow attempt (bonus modal submission, or an in-game guess with one word per category), regardless of success. NULL = not classified (historical rows).

columns.name: is_one_away
columns.comment: Guess contained exactly 3 words of one unsolved category. NULL = not recorded (historical rows).

columns.name: is_almost_rainbow
columns.comment: Guess contained exactly 3 of the 4 Rainbow herring words. NULL = not recorded (historical rows).

columns.name: active_time_seconds
columns.comment: Cumulative ACTIVE play seconds at the moment of this guess (background-tab time already excluded). NULL = not recorded (historical rows).

columns.name: groups_solved
columns.comment: Normal categories already solved when this guess was submitted (0-4). NULL = not recorded (historical rows).

columns.name: attempt_type
columns.comment: normal | bonus_rainbow. The authoritative record of an EXPLICIT post-completion "Spot the Rainbow" submission. NULL = historical row (never backfilled). Use this, NOT the is_rainbow_attempt shape heuristic, to determine player intent.

columns.name: server_numbered
columns.comment: True when a post-game Rainbow submission was numbered by record_bonus_rainbow itself (20260928000000), which never drops a submission. NULL on older rows, whose prompt history may be missing an attempt.

indexes.name: guess_events_bonus_rainbow_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX guess_events_bonus_rainbow_idx ON public.guess_events USING btree (game_session_id) WHERE (attempt_type = 'bonus_rainbow'::text)

indexes.name: guess_events_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX guess_events_pkey ON public.guess_events USING btree (id)

indexes.name: guess_events_session_guess_number_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX guess_events_session_guess_number_key ON public.guess_events USING btree (game_session_id, guess_number)

policies.name: Admins can read all guess events
Users can read own guess events
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM game_sessions gs
  WHERE ((gs.id = guess_events.game_session_id) AND (gs.user_id = rainbow_uid()))))

tables.name: hint_events
tables.comment: One row per hint ACTUALLY REVEALED. Opening the hint modal or viewing options is deliberately not recorded. Idempotent on (game_session_id, hint_type).

constraints.name: hint_events_game_session_id_fkey

indexes.name: hint_events_one_per_type
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX hint_events_one_per_type ON public.hint_events USING btree (game_session_id, hint_type)

indexes.name: hint_events_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX hint_events_pkey ON public.hint_events USING btree (id)

indexes.name: hint_events_session_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX hint_events_session_idx ON public.hint_events USING btree (game_session_id)

policies.name: Admins can read all hint events
Users can read own hint events
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM game_sessions gs
  WHERE ((gs.id = hint_events.game_session_id) AND (gs.user_id = rainbow_uid()))))

tables.name: luck_score_ceilings
tables.comment: Lucky Bot Luck Score ceiling ("1 in N" that scores 100). A puzzle uses the row with the latest effective_from on or before its own date, so adding a row later never changes an older puzzle's score. Add rows; do not edit old ones.

indexes.name: luck_score_ceilings_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX luck_score_ceilings_pkey ON public.luck_score_ceilings USING btree (effective_from)

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX puzzle_aggregates_pkey ON public.puzzle_aggregates USING btree (puzzle_id)

columns.name: category_emoji
columns.comment: Optional explicit category visual, stored literally (e.g. '___ 💬', ':caveman:'). NULL = fall back to the emoji at the end of the category title (older puzzles).

columns.name: category_emoji_hint_only
columns.comment: When true, this category's Category Emoji appears in the Full Hint but is NOT appended to the category name on the solved bar. Never alters the category name itself. Meaningless without a category_emoji, and never stored as true in that case.

constraints.name: puzzle_groups_puzzle_id_fkey

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM puzzles
  WHERE ((puzzles.id = puzzle_groups.puzzle_id) AND ((puzzles.is_published = true) OR (puzzles.is_beta = true)))))

columns.name: content

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX puzzle_versions_puzzle_id_version_number_key ON public.puzzle_versions USING btree (puzzle_id, version_number)

policies.name: Admins can read all puzzle versions
Anyone can read published puzzle versions
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM puzzles p
  WHERE ((p.id = puzzle_versions.puzzle_id) AND (p.is_published = true))))

columns.name: current_version_id
columns.comment: The newest puzzle_versions row for this puzzle: the canonical current definition. Enforced to belong to this same puzzle. Written only by admin_save_puzzle().

columns.name: is_beta
columns.comment: Unlisted playtest status. Mutually exclusive with is_published (see puzzles_not_beta_and_published). Metadata, not gameplay content -- never versioned.

columns.name: designer_name
columns.comment: Display name shown in the puzzle header as "by <designer_name>". Metadata, not gameplay content -- never versioned. Trimmed and defaulted to 'Sam West' by admin_save_puzzle() when blank.

columns.name: alphabetize_completed
columns.comment: Whether this puzzle's solved-category bar shows its answers alphabetically (true) or in the creator's authored comma-separated order (false). Gameplay content, versioned like any other field in validate_puzzle_content(). Default true.

columns.name: rainbow_category_emoji
columns.comment: Optional explicit Rainbow category visual, stored literally. NULL = fall back to the emoji at the end of rainbow_category_name.

columns.name: format
columns.comment: Board format: 'full' (4x4, 4 categories of 4) or 'mini' (3x3, 3 categories of 3). Every puzzle that predates Mini is 'full' by default.

columns.name: rainbow_category_emoji_hint_only
columns.comment: When true, the Rainbow's Category Emoji appears in the Full Hint but is NOT appended to its name on the solved bar. Never alters rainbow_category_name.

functions.name: account_email
functions.comment: The account's CURRENT email: the custom:platform identity's address (which GoTrue refreshes on every sign-in), falling back to auth.users.email (which GoTrue sets once, at creation, and never refreshes). The only place Rainbow reads an email from; accounts.global_user_id is the identity key.

functions.name: admin_find_account
functions.comment: Admin-only lookup of a Rainbow ACCOUNT by email (for granting archive access). Searches accounts, not the project's whole auth user pool.

functions.name: admin_save_puzzle
functions.comment: Atomically creates or updates a puzzle, including its Draft/Beta/Published status. Creates and promotes a new immutable version only when canonical gameplay content actually changed; metadata-only saves (status, designer_name) and no-op saves create none. Admin role required, checked inside the function.

functions.name: admin_set_custom_puzzle_status
functions.comment: Admin-only moderation switch for a custom puzzle. No UI in this phase -- exists so a follow-up moderation dashboard needs no schema change.

functions.name: complete_beta_playtest
functions.args: _playtest_id uuid, _device_id text, _device_token text, _won boolean, _mistakes integer, _hints_used boolean

functions.name: create_custom_puzzle
functions.comment: Creates an immutable player custom puzzle for anon or authenticated callers. created_by comes only from auth.uid(); share_id and short_code are generated server-side (collision-retried); a signed-in creator gets a public creator profile lazily.

functions.name: create_game_session
functions.args: _puzzle_id text, _device_id text, _device_token text, _entry_context text, _active_time_seconds integer, _mistakes integer, _puzzle_version_id uuid
functions.comment: Creates an in_progress official session, pinned to the puzzle version the player's board was built from. Refuses (returns NULL) for a device that cannot be verified, a puzzle that is not currently Published (covers Draft and Beta alike), or a Rainbow account playing on a device that still holds undecided guest history (see resolve_device_import). A session already created while its puzzle WAS published is never retroactively affected by a later status change -- only creation is gated here.

functions.name: delete_local_account
functions.comment: Removes a Rainbow account: anonymises its game_sessions (user_id and device_id cleared; rows stay for site-wide aggregates), deletes its streaks and ratings, then deletes the auth user so GoTrue and Rainbow cascades finish the job. Touches only Rainbow objects and that one auth user.

functions.name: delete_my_account
functions.comment: Self-service deletion for the signed-in Rainbow account. The shared (WorkOS) identity is untouched; signing in again creates a fresh, empty Rainbow account.

functions.name: ensure_account
functions.returns: TABLE(outcome text, user_id uuid, global_user_id text, email text, created_at timestamp with time zone)
functions.comment: Called by the client after every sign-in. Creates the caller's accounts row from their custom:platform identity (or bumps last_seen_at) and returns it with outcome ok. Answers not_platform_linked (no account row) for an auth user with no such identity, which the client treats as "not a Rainbow account": local sign-out, stay a guest. Never raises.

functions.name: finalize_game_session
functions.args: _session_id uuid, _device_id text, _device_token text, _won boolean, _mistakes integer, _active_time_seconds integer, _found_rainbow boolean, _rainbow_solve_index smallint, _solve_order jsonb, _hints_used boolean, _share_grid text, _skip_streak boolean, _local_date text

functions.name: game_sessions_sync_status
functions.comment: BEFORE INSERT/UPDATE on game_sessions. Repairs status/completed_at for cached pre-Task-6 clients that predate the status column, and on INSERT decides is_official by the same first-completed-result rule finalize_game_session applies on the RPC path.

functions.name: get_archive_puzzles
functions.returns: TABLE(id uuid, date date, title text)

functions.name: get_creator_profile
functions.comment: Public creator page data: display name, totals and the creator's Public, non-moderated puzzles only (sort: newest | plays | favorites). Returns only explicitly listed safe fields.

functions.name: get_custom_puzzle
functions.comment: Fetches one custom puzzle by its share_id, or null if it does not exist or has been hidden by moderation. Public and Private puzzles are fetched identically -- Private's only protection is the unguessable share_id itself.

functions.name: get_custom_puzzle_by_short_code
functions.comment: Fetches one custom puzzle by short_code (Public and Private alike; the code is the access mechanism). Same shape as get_custom_puzzle. Null if unknown or hidden by moderation.

functions.name: get_custom_puzzle_stats
functions.comment: Aggregate completed-play stats for one custom puzzle (by share_id, so Private stats require possessing the link): completed plays, wins, losses, average guesses over wins, and the fixed 4/5/6/7/8+ distribution. Never returns anything row-level.

functions.name: get_luck_report
functions.comment: Lucky Bot Luck numbers for the caller's own first official attempt at a Full puzzle: eligible player count, how many took the same exact guess path, and the puzzle's ceiling. Counts only; never exposes another player's path or session.

functions.name: get_own_completed_sessions
functions.returns: TABLE(puzzle_id text, won boolean, mistakes integer, found_rainbow boolean, solve_order jsonb, hints_used boolean, rainbow_solve_index smallint, rainbow_source text, bonus_rainbow_attempted boolean, status text)

functions.name: get_own_streak
functions.returns: TABLE(current_streak integer, longest_streak integer, last_played_date text)

functions.name: get_puzzle_report
functions.comment: Aggregate-only Lucky Bot report for one Full puzzle: player counts, perfect solves (and everyone else as having made a wrong guess), first-solved histogram, Rainbow found / found first / found last, skill-score histogram, and the three most common wrong guesses (never the Rainbow find itself). Never exposes an individual session. Returns null for a Mini puzzle.

functions.name: get_puzzle_stats
functions.comment: Aggregate-only per-puzzle stats for the "Global Stats" UI: every official completed session (anonymous + signed-in, wins + losses), across game_sessions. Never exposes individual rows.

functions.name: get_streak_admin_summary
functions.returns: TABLE(accounts_with_streaks integer, max_current_streak integer, max_longest_streak integer)

functions.name: luck_eligible_paths
functions.returns: TABLE(session_id uuid, user_id uuid, device_id text, path jsonb)
functions.comment: Internal. Every Luck-eligible session for one Full puzzle with its normalized ordered guess path. Never granted to clients: get_luck_report returns counts only.

functions.name: my_account
functions.returns: TABLE(user_id uuid, global_user_id text, email text, created_at timestamp with time zone)

functions.name: rainbow_uid
functions.comment: The caller's Rainbow account id, or NULL for a guest and for any auth user without a public.accounts row. Every Rainbow function and policy uses this where it once used auth.uid(); it is the tenant boundary while the auth pool is shared.

functions.name: record_bonus_rainbow
functions.args: _session_id uuid, _device_id text, _device_token text, _guess_number integer, _words jsonb, _correct boolean, _guessed_at timestamp with time zone, _active_time_seconds integer, _groups_solved smallint

functions.name: record_hint_event
functions.args: _session_id uuid, _device_id text, _device_token text, _hint_type text, _revealed_at timestamp with time zone, _active_time_seconds integer, _guess_count smallint, _mistakes smallint, _groups_solved smallint, _rainbow_found boolean

functions.name: resolve_device_import
functions.returns: TABLE(outcome text, games_played integer, current_streak integer, longest_streak integer)
functions.comment: Asked on every signed-in load: does THIS device still owe the one-time import decision? unauthenticated | no_guest_history | already_decided | credential_invalid | import_available (+ counts). Never writes.

functions.name: skill_score
functions.args: _won boolean, _mistakes integer, _solve_order jsonb, _found_rainbow boolean, _rainbow_source text, _format text
functions.comment: Lucky Bot skill score for one finished session. Full: 74–100 for a win, 50+ for a loss. Mini: the original 50–99 formula, unchanged. Mirrors src/lib/skillScore.ts exactly; keep the two in step.

functions.name: submit_beta_feedback
functions.args: _puzzle_id uuid, _puzzle_version_id uuid, _playtest_id uuid, _tester_name text, _fun_rating smallint, _difficulty_rating smallint, _rainbow_fairness_rating smallint, _confusing_or_incorrect text, _additional_comments text, _would_play_again boolean

functions.name: submit_custom_puzzle_result
functions.args: _share_id text, _device_id text, _device_token text, _won boolean, _total_guesses smallint, _run_id uuid
functions.comment: Counts one completed run (identified by _run_id) for (custom_puzzle, device). A repeat of the same run is a no-op that still returns true; a completed replay has a new run id and counts once more. Never writes to any official or Beta table.

functions.name: validate_custom_puzzle_content
functions.comment: Validates and canonicalises a player-submitted custom puzzle. Unlike validate_puzzle_content, enforces one-Rainbow-answer-per-group (not just 4-of-16) and rejects any Rainbow content on a classic puzzle.

functions.name: validate_puzzle_content
functions.comment: Canonicalises and validates official puzzle content for its format (absent format = full). Full: 4 groups of 4, difficulties 1-4, optional 4-word Rainbow. Mini: 3 groups of 3, difficulties 2-4, optional 3-word Rainbow taking exactly one answer from each category. A Category Emoji may be flagged Hint Only, which is emitted only alongside an emoji.

functions.name: xw_cast_vote
functions.args: p_puzzle uuid, p_player uuid, p_clue text

functions.name: xw_react
functions.args: p_puzzle uuid, p_player uuid, p_reaction text
